result.summary: The page is generally clean; the main visible defect is in the bottom navigation where the Orders tab appears to be missing its icon while the other tabs have icons. Excluded edge-clipped carousel items and bottom viewport cutoff were not reported per instructions.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only its text label with empty space above it, while Home, Search, and Profile all have visible icons. This makes the nav bar look inconsistent and may hurt tap-target recognition.
issues.suggestion: Restore/add the Orders icon (e.g., receipt/list glyph) so all four bottom-nav items have aligned icon-plus-label treatment.
